title: Significance of the Insignificant
subtitle: No matter how small they are, they will fight to make a difference.

items.text: Paper Heron catches the sword midair, using its edge to deflect the ink droplets surging toward her from the side.
Seeing this, Master Rén lunges forward half a step, barring the doorway.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Return the sword to me.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Not while I yet breathe.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: So be it. It will spare me from listening to another of your worthless lectures.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You entrusted that sword to me long ago. Why not simply hand it over and return to your carefree wandering?

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Perhaps you aren't so free from desire!
Amid the flames, blades flash. Paper Heron and Master Rén remain locked in combat.
Beams blaze above them. Chéng Héguāng dodges as collapsing timbers fall nearby, only now realizing that his commander has vanished within the smoke and fled into the night.
Suddenly, as if ten thousand drums were struck at once, the earth trembles and quakes.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: What's going on?
Paper Heron whips around toward the patch of sky visible through the study's courtyard.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Lǎnzhū.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: The beast has awakened.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: The moment has come at last. You are weak, Heron. Your Qi will not be enough to contend with Lǎnzhū.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Keep the sword if you must. I will ascend with or without it!
Her triumphant laughter rings out as she leaps away over the growing fires.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: She—

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Don't, Chéng. *cough*

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: It's too late.
Darkness engulfs half the sky, devouring the moonlight. The earth trembles as if it were breathing. Panicked civilians flood the streets.
Fire-lit columns of smoke rise over the other half. Beams collapse, bricks crumble. The calamity has arrived.

items.speaker: County Resident II
items.text: Earthquake! It's an earthquake!

items.speaker: County Resident II
items.text: The ground is splitting apart! I saw someone fall into it. Help! Get help!!

items.speaker: County Resident III
items.text: My house!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: This-This is Lǎnzhū's power.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Rén has agitated it, forcing its Qi to surge just so she can siphon it for herself. She is inviting a disaster greater than any known before.
Against the swirling trample of the helpless civilians, a parade advances, chanting above the panicked din around them.

items.speaker: School of Mei Believers
items.text: Withered grass devours bone. On icy plain the spirits moan.

items.speaker: School of Mei Believers
items.text: When the city falls, the Immortal descends. Longevity granted, no death, no end.

items.speaker: County Resident II
items.text: What-What on earth is happening?

items.speaker: School of Mei Believer II
items.text: The path lies untraveled, but the end has begun!

items.speaker: School of Mei Believer II
items.text: Seek salvation in longevity!

items.speaker: County Resident II
items.text: Salvation? Longevity? How?

items.speaker: County Resident II
items.text: Help us, Immortal One!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Hmph. They think Rén is here to save them. Ridiculous!
Paper Heron stands amid the wreckage of a street, feeling strangely helpless despite herself.
She holds the Longevity Sword, bows her head, and lets out a deep sigh.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: This is all because of me. I brought all of this upon us.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: When the White Horse School collapsed, I couldn't bear to see the Method of Longevity disappear. I believed that sharing it with Rén would be for the benefit of all.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: But I forgot that with fortune comes disaster, and how easily a well-intended deed can lead to peril.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: The Method itself is not wicked, and those who put their faith in Rén are not evil in nature, but I-I entrusted a dangerous tool to the wrong person.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I am the one to blame.
It's difficult to read her expression. He cannot help but see the hellish disaster reflected in the depths of her eyes.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: And I must be the one to end it.
Paper Heron surveys the scene ahead of her.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: You need to leave.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Leave? Where to?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Anywhere but here. If you go now and run day and night, you may yet survive.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Why?
She looks up, surprised at the fury in Chéng Héguāng's tone.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: If I flee now, how am I any different from those cowardly lords?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I may no longer be Chief Constable, but I still answer to my conscience!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: You don't fear death?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I fear living in regret.
He clutches his fists. The fire in his eyes burns brighter than any mere reflection.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You trusted me with your sword. I cannot repay you with abandonment.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Lì Huìfēng has fled, but I still have his token to command the other constables.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I will aid you in any way I can.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: But this is no ordinary crisis. I cannot guarantee your safety.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: All the more reason.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I'll come find you once I instruct the other constables to evacuate the townsfolk.
Seeing the young man's resolve, Paper Heron nods.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Be careful.
They exchange a quick glance. Chéng Héguāng turns and leaps back into the burning ruins. Paper Heron casts an incantation and vanishes from the spot.
